title: Bob's letter from Nixon thanking him for cooperation on the project

tellings.quote: thing the thing that was a controversy around Bob was the the fact that Bob got a letter from Nixon and said, "Thank you for your cooperation on the project we're working on."

plain: In the 1970s, a man in Los Angeles known only as Bob is said to have received a letter from President Richard Nixon that read, "Thank you for your cooperation on the project we're working on." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron, who says he knew of it at first hand, says this letter is what made Bob controversial, since it would suggest the president was tied to whatever secret project Bob was part of.
